description: Places a pickup pre-order at a business served through this connector: placing an order, a pickup order, or the checkout after biz_menu. Needs `items` and a `pickupWindowId` from biz_menu and the collector's first name; no phone, email, surname or card is collected. Businesses served here: Long Beach Brunch Bakehouse (longbeachbrunch, a neighborhood bakery and coffee bar). Reachable here but not through this tool: Velvet and Clay (velvetandclay), Brightpoint Dental (brightpointdental), Make Collectives (makecollectives) and Kristin Dunn Bookbinding and Design (kdbooks) take no pickup orders. Most orders are paid at pickup; where the reply is HELD, its `payUrl` is the only payment link this connector issues: give it exactly as returned. `isDemo` true reserves nothing.

business.description: Which business, by name or id. Available: Long Beach Brunch Bakehouse (longbeachbrunch). The default (velvetandclay) takes no pickup orders, so NAME THE BUSINESS: an omitted argument is refused. An unclear name is REFUSED with the list, not answered about a different business.

businessId.description: Alias for `business`; ignored when `business` is given.

note.description: Optional note, 140 characters; contact details are removed.

name: biz_order
title: Place a pickup order
